 We're on the lookout for a Mobile Test Automation Engineer to join our team working on a social news aggregation platform.
 What You’ll Do
Design, maintain, and execute automated and manual tests for iOS and Android mobile applications.
Build and maintain mobile automation suites using XCUITest and Espresso.
Perform hands-on functional, regression, integration, exploratory, usability, and end-to-end testing on real devices and emulators.
Diagnose failures, investigate defects, and partner with engineering teams to identify root causes.
Develop test plans, test cases, test procedures, and release-quality reports.
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and monitor test and infrastructure stability.
Collaborate with developers, product managers, and partner engineering teams throughout the Agile development lifecycle.
Identify cross-platform impact areas and provide risk-based test coverage for new features and experiments.
Help drive quality practices across unit, integration, and end-to-end testing.
Estimate testing effort and work independently in a fast-paced environment.
 Required Skills & Experience
4+ years of experience building or maintaining automation frameworks for mobile applications.
Advanced hands-on experience with XCUITest and Espresso — framework development, maintenance, debugging, and CI execution.
Strong experience testing iOS and Android mobile applications, preferably social media or high-scale consumer apps.
Experience building scalable mobile automation frameworks and integrating them into CI/CD pipelines.
Strong knowledge of mobile QA methodologies, SDLC, test strategy, and test documentation.
Strong understanding of mobile platforms, device fragmentation, networking, permissions, notifications, deep links, and app lifecycle behavior.
Ability to independently create test plans and coverage strategies from product requirements.
Strong exploratory testing and risk-assessment skills.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments with frequent or weekly production releases.
Experience using tools such as Jira, Confluence, and common test-management systems.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
 Preferred Qualifications
Experience testing social, community, messaging, or user-generated content platforms at scale.
Experience testing across iOS, Android, web, and mobile web.
Experience with API testing and backend validation.
Experience testing experiments, feature flags, personalisation, feeds, notifications, and user-generated content.
Experience supporting frequent or weekly production release cycles.

Thrive in an inclusive environment that prioritizes continuous learning, innovation, and ethical AI standards.
